_comment: Copy this to device.json next to setlist.json and edit it for THIS machine.
device.json is gitignored on purpose: the gig laptop and the backup laptop
have different interfaces, and the set list must stay portable between them.
Buses are named here; setlist.json only ever refers to the names.
"device" matches part of the interface name, so "UMC404HD" is enough.
"api" picks the driver family. Leave it empty to take the best one
present. On Windows this matters a great deal: the same speakers appear
under WASAPI at ~3 ms and under MME at ~100 ms, and MME is what the
backend calls the default. Set it to "ASIO" once the interface driver
is installed - ASIO is the only way to get four separate outputs.
